text: バイクの　ちょうしが　よく　ならねーぜ

structure.jp: バイクの　ちょうしが

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: A describing word with its い changed to く, followed by なる, means 'become that way'; いい turns into よく. よく　ならねー = 'doesn't get better'.

patterns.name: 〜ない
patterns.explanation: ねー is a rough, slurred way of saying ない, 'not'. ならねー = ならない = 'doesn't become'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is a rough, tough-guy way of pushing your statement at the listener. ならねーぜ = 'it ain't getting there, man'.
